text: Seamless steady outdoor racing spectator ambience from medium-distant trackside grandstands. A modest crowd murmuring, scattered serious cheers, clapping and occasional wordless whoops as racers pass. Restrained believable sports atmosphere with open-air distance, not a deafening stadium roar. No intelligible words, announcer, music, engines, vehicles, horns or whistles. Consistent texture and level, no intro or ending.
